title: Zscaler CEO: AI Models Are Raising Demand for Security
text: Zscaler shares rose about 4% as the company reaffirmed its first-quarter and full-year guidance at investor day. CEO Jay Chaudhry said businesses see AI as a way to boost revenue and efficiency, but worry that AI agents could create cybersecurity risks, driving stronger demand for zero-trust security. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Sally Bakewell on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
